_comment: Bounds on the median sample of each metric in a run (or the named stat). Checked by `npm run metrics:report`, which exits 1 on a breach. Ratchet, never loosen: after a good run, `npm run metrics:report -- --ratchet` tightens each bound towards that run and you commit the diff. Loosening one is a decision to record in docs/INTEGRATION_TESTS.md, not an edit to make quietly. Metrics a run did not measure (an opt-in project left off) are reported, not failed, unless --strict.

hrsh.boundary.parcel_arrived.note: The campus pin gets a parcel boundary, not the fallback circle.

hrsh.boundary.seconds_to_parcel.note: From opening the private pin page to the parcel being readable.

hrsh.boundary.area_sqm.note: EXPECTED_PARCEL_AREA_SQM in lib/hrsh.ts; REData measures 133,964 m².

hrsh.child_pins.count.note: The campus has many buildings; a dedupe fix may legitimately lower the count, so this is a floor, not a ratchet.

hrsh.child_pins.duplicate_count.note: No two child pins should stand for the same building, within site_scope.BUILDING_MATCH_METERS.

hrsh.parcel_buildings.count.note: The Buildings on this Property panel lists at least one on-property building.

hrsh.parcel_buildings.unpinned_count.note: Every building the panel lists should end up with a child pin; confident_buildings() gating (parcel_buildings.py) can leave this above zero.

hrsh.wiki.available.note: GET wikis/<location_slug>/ answers 200 without anyone creating the wiki.

hrsh.ownership.card_ready.note: The private pin page's Property Records card leaves its loading state, for both the subscriber and non-subscriber accounts.

hrsh.ownership.seconds_to_card_ready.note: Reload-polled: the panel self-polls client-side for only ~60s per page load (external_data.MAX_POLL_ATTEMPTS * POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS).

hrsh.pin_page.seconds_to_boundary_drawn.note: From opening the page to a <path> in the leaflet pane; the chain already ran, so this is fetch+render only.

hrsh.pin_page.seconds_to_first_search_ph.note: First media tile from a search/archive provider, not the user's own uploads.

hrsh.pin_page.search_source_count.note: Distinct search/archive-style media sources (excludes 'photos') that populated the gallery.

hrsh.pin_page.media_tile_count.note: Per-source tile count, tagged by provider.

hrsh.pin_page.article_reveal_ms.note: Clicking the Article tab to the seeded content rendering, once the article already exists.

hrsh.sources.buildings_with_pdf.note: Of up to 3 sampled building pins, how many show >=1 CRIS document under Article > Sources.

hrsh.sources.pdfs_per_building.note: Median CRIS document count across sampled building pins' Sources tabs.

hrsh.sources.campus_distinct_buildings.note: Distinct buildings named in the campus pin's own Sources tab; docs/PROBLEMS.md P24 says today it is only the nearest one.

hrsh.sources.wiki_distinct_buildings.note: Same, read from the campus wiki's Sources tab.

hrsh.sources.seconds_to_populate.note: From selecting the Sources tab to its first CRIS document rendering; reads already-cached attachments, so this should be fast.

hrsh.wiki.seconds_to_meaningful_title.note: From the wiki existing to its name matching HRSH_NAME_PATTERN.

hrsh.wiki.article.seconds_to_seeded.note: From the wiki existing to wikis/<slug>/article/ answering 200.

hrsh.wiki.media_tile_count.note: Auto-fetched search-result tiles in the wiki's Media card, no user action.

hrsh.wiki.child_wiki_count.note: Sampled building child pins whose location resolves to a child wiki; see hrsh-wiki-auto.spec.ts.

hrsh.child_pins.missing_child_wiki_count.note: Sampled building child pins with no wiki at their own location; mirror_buildings_to_wiki (pin_restructure.py) swallows its own exceptions, so a positive count is real signal.

hrsh.photo_placement.upload_to_visible_s.note: From starting the upload of a no-GPS photo to its tile carrying the no-gps badge in the map sidebar's Photos panel, with no reload.

hrsh.photo_placement.drop_to_marker_ms.note: From starting the drag of an unplaced photo onto #map to the reposition POST answering.

hrsh.photo_placement.placement_error_met.note: Distance between the pixel the test dropped on (via the page's own map.containerPointToLatLng) and the coordinate the server saved. Recorded under MetricUnit "count" - lib/metrics.ts has no metres unit; see hrsh-photo-placement.spec.ts.

hrsh.floorplan.seconds_to_walls_drawn.note: From opening a building's private pin page to seedFromOutline's exterior walls rendering after following the Floorplan link, no interaction beyond that click.

hrsh.floorplan.wall_count.note: seedFromOutline needs >=3 outline points to draw anything; the exact count tracks whichever building was picked, not a target to tighten.

hrsh.sanborn.overlay_count.note: At least one MapImageOverlay (the auto-found Sanborn sheet) exists on the pin/wiki map with no user click.

hrsh.sanborn.map_count.note: Of those overlays, how many are named /sanborn/i; nothing auto-seeds one today (hrsh-sanborn.spec.ts).

hrsh.sanborn.seconds_to_present.note: From opening the pin/wiki page to a Sanborn-named overlay appearing in #map-overlays-data.
